migrations.summary: 候选版场景下，runtime status 提示的下一条命令带上 --latest。; check 发现重复的 Skill / MCP 分组时，追加一行提示 inventory、dedupe、relocate。; Cursor 没有发布信息时，check 的末行不再写“全部为最新”，改为明确说无法判断。; 新增客户端 Antigravity（agy）：只靠一份驱动声明、夹具和随包的 hooks.json 与 mcp_config.json 接入。install、update（卸载后重装）、check、sync、nudge hook、inventory、doctor 认识 agy；不在默认客户端集合里，须 --client agy。; 修正 Antigravity（agy）的 hook：按官方文档的载荷键（workspacePaths、conversationId）找项目目录与会话，Stop 改用 {"decision":"continue"} 输出；既有客户端的 hook 行为不变。; install、update 与旧安装清理改为读客户端的分发声明：命令步骤、已装插件状态的读取方式与每客户端文案进入声明；既有三个客户端的输出不变。; 内置客户端声明改为数据文件，行为不变。; 新增已弃用的 Gemini CLI 客户端声明（gemini，不在默认集合，须 --client gemini 或 --client all 点名）：install / update 用其 extensions install / uninstall 命令，该命令会向你索取文件夹信任确认，--apply 时直接使用你的终端，agenthelm 不代答、不转发、不绕过，没有终端时不启动命令；新增只读的已装扩展状态读取（~/.gemini/extensions）。本版发布包没有随包提供 Gemini 要求的 gemini-extension.json，不带 --source 的安装会在预览里受阻；真实 Gemini CLI 的行为尚未在本版验证。既有 claude / codex / cursor 的输出不变。; nudge 与 hook 输出改读客户端声明：事件名映射、输出格式、停止提示默认值与旧安装的载荷嗅探都来自 drivers/*.json，既有三个客户端的输出不变。; 客户端读取侧改为读驱动声明：优先级、读取格式与受管条目进入声明；0 字节的 MCP 配置文件不再被判为损坏。; 同级插件的查找统一为一个解析函数：已装用户级运行时时，优先于客户端缓存里的副本。; sync 的写入侧改读客户端声明：包目的地、MCP 写入格式与选项、Codex 的 TOML 写入与残留清理、Cursor 的请求头写法、作用域与遮蔽发现都进入声明；既有三个客户端写出的文件与输出不变。; 各插件的英文目录改为按键排序，并行新增文案的分支合并时不再冲突；加载出的译文不变。; check 能读取 latest.json 的迁移窗口：落后很多版本时按需取全量迁移说明，取不到时明确提示并按可能不兼容处理；不兼容步骤缺摘要时不再显示 None。
migrations.summary_en: In a candidate (-rc.N) scenario, the next command that runtime status suggests carries --latest.; When check finds duplicate Skill / MCP groups, it adds one line pointing at inventory, dedupe and relocate.; When Cursor has no release information, the last line of check no longer says everything is up to date; it says it cannot tell.; Antigravity (agy) is a declared client: one driver declaration, fixtures and the shipped hooks.json and mcp_config.json. install, update (uninstall then reinstall), check, sync, nudge hook, inventory and doctor know agy; it is not in the default client set, name it with --client agy.; Fix the Antigravity (agy) hooks: find the project and the conversation from the documented payload keys (workspacePaths, conversationId) and answer Stop with a {"decision":"continue"} output; the hooks of the existing clients are unchanged.; install, update and legacy cleanup now follow the client distribution declarations: command steps, how installed plugins are read and per-client wording are declared data; the output for the existing three clients is unchanged.; Built-in client declarations are now data files; behavior is unchanged.; Adds a declaration for Gemini CLI as a deprecated client (gemini, outside the default set: name it with --client gemini or --client all). install / update use its extensions install / uninstall commands; that command asks you to confirm folder trust, so --apply hands it your terminal and agenthelm does not answer, forward or bypass the question, and does not start the command without a terminal. Adds read-only reading of installed extensions (~/.gemini/extensions). This release does not ship the gemini-extension.json that Gemini requires, so an install without --source is blocked in the preview; the behaviour of the real Gemini CLI is not verified in this version. Output for the existing claude / codex / cursor clients is unchanged.; The nudge and hook output now follow the client declarations: event names, output formats, stop-prompt defaults and the legacy payload sniffing come from drivers/*.json; output for the three existing clients is unchanged.; The read side now follows the client driver declarations: precedence, read formats and managed entries are declared data, and a 0-byte MCP configuration file is no longer reported as corrupt.; Sibling plugins are now found by one resolver; an installed user-level runtime is preferred over client-cache copies.; The write side of sync now follows the client declarations: package destinations, the MCP write format and its options, Codex TOML writing and residual cleanup, the Cursor headers form, and scope and shadowing findings are declared data; the files and output written for the existing three clients are unchanged.; The plugins' English catalogs are now sorted by key, so branches that add messages in parallel merge without conflicts; the loaded translations are unchanged.; check reads the latest.json migration window: when far behind it fetches the full migration notes, and when they are unavailable it says so and treats the update as possibly incompatible; a breaking step without a summary no longer shows None.

migrations.summary: refresh 与 entry 在 private/.gitignore 是另一种语言的工具原文时，预览中列出并在 --apply 时先备份再换成项目文件语言的版本；check 给出信息级提示。; check 在 Profile 与内容锁记录的渲染输入不一致时给出提示（信息级，不影响退出码）。; agents-init 的拒绝与回滚提示全部走翻译：中文界面显示中文，英文界面输出不变。; 各插件的英文目录改为按键排序，并行新增文案的分支合并时不再冲突；加载出的译文不变。
migrations.summary_en: refresh and entry list a private/.gitignore that holds the tool's text in the other language and, on --apply, back it up and replace it with the project file language's version; check reports it as information.; check now reports when the Profile no longer matches the render inputs recorded in the content lock (information only, exit code unchanged).; agents-init refusal and rollback messages now go through translation: Chinese in the Chinese interface, unchanged text in English.; The plugins' English catalogs are now sorted by key, so branches that add messages in parallel merge without conflicts; the loaded translations are unchanged.

migrations.summary: 各插件的英文目录改为按键排序，并行新增文案的分支合并时不再冲突；加载出的译文不变。
migrations.summary_en: The plugins' English catalogs are now sorted by key, so branches that add messages in parallel merge without conflicts; the loaded translations are unchanged.

migrations.summary_en: Fix the missing separator between the default marker and the action in the English update-content preview (defaultkeep your version).; A project tool that times out is reported as an unknown write outcome, distinct from a failure to start, instead of being treated as not written.; The plugins' English catalogs are now sorted by key, so branches that add messages in parallel merge without conflicts; the loaded translations are unchanged.

dedupe 与 relocate 的预览新增影响面（impact）：退役或迁移前先按各客户端读取的文件位置算出谁会失去、保留或改读哪一份，符号链接悬空与「其他机器上的该项目不再带有它」写成警告；只多信息，不改写入语义，状态仍为 ready。; inventory 与 dedupe 判断 MCP 目标：指纹相同但目标不同或无法确认的条目不再算重复，改列入 mcp_hints；每条 MCP 新增 target 与 target_class。; 已弃用的 Gemini 的弃用说明在一次 install / update 的输出里只出现一次（放在该客户端的第一个步骤），文字不变；其他客户端的输出不变。; Gemini 的驱动声明补上 nudge-install-hooks（hooks 随扩展交付，与支持矩阵一致），并新增守卫：矩阵标不支持或不适用的功能必须由驱动声明，驱动声明的不支持项矩阵里也要有。
migrations.summary_en: dedupe and relocate previews gain an impact section: before retiring or moving a Skill or MCP entry they work out, from the file locations each client reads, who loses it, keeps it or reads a different copy; dangling symlinks and "projects on other machines no longer carry it" become warnings. Information only: writes are unchanged and the status stays ready.; inventory and dedupe now judge the MCP target: entries with the same fingerprint but a different or unconfirmed target are no longer duplicates and are listed in mcp_hints; every MCP entry gains target and target_class.; The deprecation note of the deprecated Gemini client appears once per install / update run (on the client's first step) with the same wording; the output for the other clients is unchanged.; The Gemini driver now declares nudge-install-hooks (hooks ship inside the extension, as the support matrix says), and a new guard reconciles the matrix with the drivers in both directions.

migrations.summary: 项目事项工具的写入调用超时时报告「写入结果未知」，与启动失败区分，不再当作没有写入。; 「技能与 MCP」菜单读取 inventory 的 target_class：指纹相同但目标不同的 MCP 不再列为「不同名 · 同指纹」重复组，mcp_hints 以一行信息显示在按重复看的末尾，不计入重复数。旧版 agent-pack 没有这两个键时分组与输出不变。
migrations.summary_en: A project item tool write that times out is reported as an unknown outcome, distinct from a failure to start, instead of being treated as not written.; The Skills & MCP menu reads target_class from the inventory: MCP entries with the same fingerprint but a different target no longer form a "different names, same fingerprint" duplicate group, and mcp_hints appear as one line at the end of the by-duplicate view without counting as duplicates. With an older agent-pack that lacks both keys, grouping and output are unchanged.
